package.name: mtl_search_planner
package.description: Multi-Agent Target Localization search planner: two vendored C++17 planners behind one SearchMission action server - mtl::planner (budgeted orienteering, Dubins calibration, cell anchors, lateral coverage, 1-DOF/2-DOF gimbal scheduling) and mtl::curve::Planner (one jointly optimised continuous curve per aircraft with a sinusoidal single-axis gimbal sweep), selected by the scenario planner.type - publishing each robot's map-frame track and boresight schedule.
